title: Moesha
description:
S6 E11 — The Player
Moesha’s attempt to solve Niecy’s 'ain’t gotta man blues' backfires.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

S2 E5 — The Great Man Hunt
Alarmed that her biological clock is winding down, Sandra sets out to find a perfect husband to father her child, but when she strikes out with the available men, she decides to have a baby anyway--regardless of her marital status.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E22 — Jingle Fever
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E1 — Been There, Done That
Malcolm's good luck streak is matched bad Eddie's sudden run of bad fortune.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E2 — Roofless People
To fix a leaky roof, the bank loan officer forces Malcolm to hire his daughter.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E3 — Casino Evil
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E4 — Sibling Rivals
Malcolm and his sister vie for the attention of the same woman.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E2 — Homecoming-Part 1
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E3 — The Homecoming-Part 2
Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.
